One declaration for both routes: a candidate DEPLOYMENT runs test-shard-<i> and doc-gate as pinned runs from the set's mw-core-tests image (/core-tests); a host PR/trunk run builds first and packs its own tree. Every shard reads the pack built from the run's own commit (--require-sha), never another set's. `owes` is what the stages still check less than dotnet-test.yml; ciEquivalent is refused while it is non-empty (check-build-stages.py, profile core).
owes: Consolidate test results: host-results brings each host shard's handed-back results into the run as the `test` matrix's own artifacts, from the runners' shared store, on the self-hosted pool — core's repository has no MW_RUNNER / MW_ARTIFACT_STORE variable today, so on the host route that job is RED naming them (Actions: collect-results over the testResults-shard<i>-attempt<a> artifacts)

fan-out: a host runs one run's stages serially — build 25 + 8 shards x 20 + doc-gate 25 minutes is past the run deadline; the deployment route already submits one pinned run per stage, but such runs do not share one $MW_BUILD_OUTPUTS, so the shards need this run's pack through the shared cache (`needs: outputs`), which today promotes only a trunk run's content-keyed output (Actions: one `build`, then the 8-way `test` matrix)

prepared packages: the build restores through the repository's nuget.config with the host's cache as the fallback folder, and a package the cache lacks is restored for the run and named; the cache is WARMED only by MeshWeaver.Deploy#42 (a succeeded trunk build's restored packages promoted into <cache>/nuget) - until that is on build-latest and a trunk build of core has run there, core's restore closure is not in the cache (Actions: the `build` job's NuGet-shelf hydration and restore)

browser: the shards that run browser tests need the headless browser and the font set the `browser-fonts` job stages and each `test` shard provisions; the build-host image (MeshWeaver.Deploy deploy/build-host/Dockerfile) carries neither
dependent legs: platform-compat and licence-gate read the `build` job's artifacts (shard 0's output, the licence evidence); with the build on a host they need its outputs handed back

prepared mesh: on a host no test may install a mesh from scratch — a prepared mesh snapshot is cloned per run; which of core's fixtures that replaces is not established (owned by the prepared-server work)
evidence: no stage has run on a host — a probe of every stage on build-latest must be green and agree with the Actions legs of the same commit

stages.name: build
stages.command: set -euo pipefail; : "${NUGET_FALLBACK_PACKAGES:?the host bound no prepared package cache (needs: nuget)}"; dotnet build MeshWeaver.slnx -c Release -p:CIRun=true -warnaserror; fetched=$({ find "${NUGET_PACKAGES:?the host bound no writable package folder}" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>/dev/null || true; } | sed -E 's#.*/([^/]+)/([^/]+)$#\1/\2#' | sort | tr '\n' ' '); if [ -n "$fetched" ]; then echo "::warning::the prepared package cache did not hold: $fetched- restored for this run; a succeeded trunk build promotes them"; else echo "every package came from the prepared cache"; fi; missing=$(comm -23 <(find test -name '*.csproj' ! -path '*/bin/*' | sort) <(grep -oE 'test/[^"]+\.csproj' MeshWeaver.slnx | sort)); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "::error::these test projects are not in MeshWeaver.slnx, so they are never built and their tests never run: $missing"; exit 1; fi; python3 deploy/core-tests/core-tests.py pack --repo . --out "${MW_BUILD_OUTPUTS:?the host names no run outputs (MW_BUILD_OUTPUTS)}/core-tests" --sha "${MW_BUILD_SHA:?the host names no commit (MW_BUILD_SHA)}" --version "run-${MW_BUILD_SHA}"
